scenario: Regex flags `i` (case-insensitive), `m` (multiline), `s` (dot-all) are the defined v1 set per LREG.5.2. Pin: `/^error/ms`, two flags combined, compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES.
rules_ds:
schema Log scope logical:
    msg: String key

rule r:
    Log e where e.msg ~ /^error/ms
->
    log info "multiline error"
